feedback.goal: Implement only confined optimizer candidate staging and actual base-byte verification while recording the accepted future evolution direction and preserving unrelated work.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Record the accepted full direction and future priorities before implementation.
Require exchange target and base binding and verify on-disk bytes before reconstruction; rejected candidates produce no candidate output.
Stage raw Markdown exclusively in the confined root, preserving existing files and rejecting symlink or outside destinations; remove the general overwrite writer.
Pass the repository check after focused verification.
Preserve unrelated recorder/controller work and evaluator ownership without model requests, external transfer, installation, activation, commits, or pushes.

outcome.summary: Bounded implementation and 31 focused tests pass; full check requires human review of the roadmap capsule source pin changed by this task.

exception.reason: The roadmap addition invalidates the existing capsule source digest. Repository guidance requires human review before refresh; the dirty capsule was preserved.
exception.next_action: Review the roadmap delta, refresh the roadmap pin in the adapter-boundary capsule, and rerun the repository check.

what_worked: Rejected candidates cannot reach the raw-Markdown staging operation.
Actual-byte drift tests distinguish inputs with identical lossy UTF-8 decoding.
Existing source and feedback changes were preserved; only DAL staging changes and their evidence are reported.
what_failed: The first focused run exposed four test-fixture failures involving physical temporary paths and an alternate workspace base; corrected before the passing runs.
The full check stopped at roadmap capsule integrity after typecheck and build passed.

evidence.summary: Focused staging contract and acceptance criteria; accepted direction is recorded separately in ROADMAP.md.
22 optimizer tests and 9 workflow tests passed, including raw output, rejection, overwrite prevention, symlink confinement, and byte-drift coverage.
Typecheck and build passed; tests reported 213 passed, 6 skipped, and 1 capsule failure. Later chained verification stages did not run.
Capsule validation fails closed because its roadmap source digest no longer matches the accepted roadmap addition; capsule contents remain untouched by this task.

Scoped changes are ROADMAP.md, docs/optimizer-staging.md, docs/requirement-evidence.md, src/cli.ts, src/json.ts, src/optimizer-adapter.ts, tests/optimizer-adapter.test.ts, tests/workflow.test.ts, and this task's feedback pair. Diff whitespace check passed. No evaluator or recorder/controller implementation was changed.

notes: Roadmap capsule refresh and implementation review remain pending. Full proposer confinement, candidate/branch receipt binding and deduplication, trace attribution, and independent paired heldout evaluation remain future work. Staging is not an OS boundary against concurrent same-user directory replacement.
